question: Duleep Trophy is associated with _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**cricket**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Duleep Trophy** is a **domestic first-class cricket competition in India**.
 
• The tournament is named after Kumar Shri Duleepsinhji of Nawanagar, who was a famous Indian cricketer.
 
• The Duleep Trophy was started by the **Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) in 1961-62**.
 
• It features teams representing geographical zones of India, such as **North Zone, South Zone, East Zone, West Zone, and Central Zone**.
 
• The competition aims to provide a platform for players to showcase their talent and make a case for selection to the national team.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• The Duleep Trophy has seen various format changes over the years, including the introduction of a pink ball and day-night matches to attract more spectators.
 
• Some of the notable players who have participated in the Duleep Trophy include **Sachin Tendulkar, Rahul Dravid, and VVS Laxman**.
 
• The tournament has helped in unearthing many talented cricketers who have gone on to represent India at the international level.
 
• The Duleep Trophy is considered a prestigious tournament in the Indian domestic cricket calendar.
